test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following States / Union Territories has the best sex ratio according to Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala has the highest sex ratio of 1084 females per 1000 males as per the census 2011 in all Indian states.**
 
• **The sex ratio is used to describe the number of females per 1000 males.**
 
• In the Population Census of 2011, it was revealed that the population ratio in India in 2011 is 943 females per 1000 males.
 
• **Haryana has the lowest sex ratio (877) in Indian states.**
 
• Puducherry has the highest sex ratio of 1037 while Daman and Diu have the lowest sex ratio (618) among all the union territories of India.
